messages:
maria: Heads up — NorthStar Analytics is reporting p95 token latency spikes from Dedicated pool d-prod-2, started ~10:15 UTC. We're seeing p95 ~1.8s (SLA target 600ms). Ticket: INC-4629. Anyone from eng-platform own this?
kevin: On it. Do we have any correlation with batch sizes or quantized variants?
maria: Appears after config rollout 2026-03-07T10:00 (autoscaler heuristic). Quick log snippet:```
2026-03-07T10:12:03Z INFO batch_size=128 model=ns-bert-8q p95=1820ms node=d-prod-2-14
2026-03-07T10:12:04Z WARN kv-cache-miss=0.12
```
sneh: I'm running a query on batch-size distribution now. @eng-infra any recent node restarts?
on-call-bot: Incident created INC-4629 • severity: P1 • assignee: unassigned • https://incidents.redwood/INC-4629
oliver: Proposed immediate mitigations: 1) clamp autoscaler max_batch to 32 on d-prod-2 (owner: oliver) 2) route high-QPS customers to hosted fallback for 4h (owner: liz) 3) hotfix to growth algorithm to prefer lower-latency path. Config change can be applied in ~15m.
liz: I can do the reroute. Need a list of affected customers and confirmation on allowed behavior (throttle vs route). @maria can you confirm NorthStar's preference?
maria: Confirmed with NorthStar: keep correctness, can accept lowered throughput for a few hours but they want ETA and a public-facing note.
kevin: I'll prepare a small PR to clamp growth and run canary. If canary passes, we can roll to prod within ~2h. PR: https://git.redwood/repo/pull/714
product-sam: Noting for CS: please prepare communication + credit plan if incident >2h.
sneh: I'll own the postmortem and dependency list. Adding initial notes to INC-4629. Need oliver and kevin as action owners.
deploy-bot: Deploy triggered by kevin for commit abc1234 -> Rolling canary on d-canary-3. Status: running.
kevin: Canary tests green, rolling to 20% prod nodes in 20m. Monitoring p95.
maria: Thanks everyone. Please update INC-4629 with exact ETA/timeline and mark owners (oliver: config; kevin: hotfix+deploy; liz: reroute).
oliver: Clamping autoscaler now on d-prod-2. Will report once stable.
liz: Starting reroute for heavy customers; will keep throughput limits and log actions.
kevin: Prod rollout at 2026-03-07T12:05 UTC, observing p95 dropping to ~580ms on initial cohort. Will continue monitoring and post final status.
maria: Great progress — keep this thread for async updates. If SLA breach looks likely, escalate to legal/Sales. :thumbsup:
